en: 1 Corinthians 16

p.src: 1  Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

en: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
u.src: 1  Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

p.src: 2  On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

en: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
u.src: 2  On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

p.src: 3  When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

en: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
u.src: 3  When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

p.src: 4  If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

en: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
u.src: 4  If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

p.src: 5  I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

en: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
u.src: 5  I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

p.src: 6  But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

en: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
u.src: 6  But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

p.src: 7  For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

en: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
u.src: 7  For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

p.src: 8  But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

en: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
u.src: 8  But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

p.src: 9  for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

en: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
u.src: 9  for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

p.src: 10  Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

en: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
u.src: 10  Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

p.src: 11  Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

en: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
u.src: 11  Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

p.src: 12  Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

en: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
u.src: 12  Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

p.src: 13  Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

en: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
u.src: 13  Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

p.src: 14  Let all that you do be done in love.

en: Let all that you do be done in love.
u.src: 14  Let all that you do be done in love.

p.src: 15  Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

en: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—
u.src: 15  Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

p.src: 16  that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

en: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
u.src: 16  that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

p.src: 17  I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

en: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
u.src: 17  I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

p.src: 18  For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

en: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
u.src: 18  For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

p.src: 19  The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

en: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
u.src: 19  The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

p.src: 20  All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

en: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
u.src: 20  All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

p.src: 21  This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

en: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
u.src: 21  This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

p.src: 22  If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

en: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
u.src: 22  If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

en:
16:22 Greek: anathema.
16:22 Aramaic: Maranatha!

p.src: 23  The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
u.src: 23  The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

p.src: 24  My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

en: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
u.src: 24  My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
